title: Knowing Duke Ellington's musicians; Bonnie's family
summary: She knew many Ellington men from the Capitol, including Sonny Greer, Braud, Barney Bigard and Benny Carter. She talks about Bigard's father, family and relatives.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
